results.name: starter board: sticky + ellipse joined by a BOUND arrow, Layers list names them, module is in the launcher
draw shapes with the pointer: rect by drag (snapped), ellipse by click (default size), pen stroke, sticky note with two lines of text
connector follows: an arrow drawn from the rect to the ellipse binds both ends and stays on the rect's outline when the rect is dragged
keyboard: Layers list selects, arrows nudge (Shift = 10), Ctrl+D duplicates, Delete removes, Ctrl+Z undoes; the text field edits
arrange: marquee selects only enclosed elements, Align Left lines them up, Group makes one selection
files: Save .fboard, reopen it from its path, Export SVG (escaped, no script); a hostile .fboard is repaired and the count reported
axe-core: default, with a selection (style + arrange panels), and with the text editor open — no serious/critical violations
